'''Quillin Arkell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Velabri (species)|Velabri]] and a member of the elite [[Velabri Lancers]]. He worked alongside [[Cryle Cavv]] and [[Finn Varatha]] in the extraction of deep-cover agent [[Rivoche Tarkin]]. Following the rescue, Cavv got [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] to assign Arkell and Varatha to his newly reinstated [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Special Ops]] Group.<ref name="Small Favors" />
